_comment: PLANNED TOPICS — the visible roadmap (operator, 2026-08-08: 'create all departments and fill
out taxonomies now, and if there is no material add some kind of visual work in progress').
This file is NOT a pack. The loader skips anything beginning with '_', so nothing here can be
opened, mastered, or counted toward a certificate. It exists so a department can exist before
its courses do, and so a student can see where the school is going.
HONESTY RULE: an entry here is a stated intention, not a promise with a date. The UI labels
these 'In development' and they are not clickable. When a pack ships, DELETE its entry — a
roadmap that still advertises what already exists is how the old _roadmap.json became stale
(every topic it listed had since been built).
Order within a category follows the order of this list.
